name: 4d-blog-engine
description: 4D Blog Engine — operationalizes the 4D AI Fluency Framework (Delegation, Description, Discernment, Diligence) for content production. Hard-wired to Payload CMS as the publishing backend. v0.3.2 makes /blog-init writer-first: the form only asks 5 questions a writer can answer (folder pick, folder pick, author name, hero vibe, optional live URL). Every Payload-technical value (content collection, media collection, API base URL, auth status) is auto-detected from payload.config.* and .env.local — no interrogation. Hero vibes are a fixed set of 4 (neutral, warm, bold, dark) with baked-in palettes; no brand option ever named after a specific site. v0.3.1 decoupled the hero-image flow from any one site's brand. v0.3.0 introduced the OS folder picker and the Payload-aware marker file (schema v2). v0.2.0 added the /blog-init, /blog-start, /publish lifecycle. Pipeline: takes a base document and an angle question; runs a 30-day discourse sweep across reddit, X, Hacker News, Substack, Facebook, Quora, podcasts, and academic sources; layers a /council:deliberate synthesis pass; builds a verified bibliography with AI-generated abstracts; drafts the blog post in the configured voice using the existing research-pipeline + editorial-forge skills; runs a two-tier anti-AI-slop pass (deterministic linter + LLM structural review with a second-pass audit); and ships through a nonce-bound Release Owner Gate scoring against a 100-point rubric. On a clean gate, produces a publication-ready blog post, a long-form LinkedIn article (full mirror, blog stays canonical), and a short hook-led LinkedIn teaser with a 3-axis scorecard. Trigger phrases: 'write a blog post from this document', 'derive a blog from this whitepaper', '/4d-blog-engine', 'set up the blog plugin', 'publish this post', 'release-owner gate'. Implements the Release Owner Gate from MoxyWolf's 'Beyond the Prompt' whitepaper.
